> Act II Scene I A hall in Leonato’s house. Enter Leonato, Antonio, Hero, Beatrice, and others. Leonato Was not Count John here at supper? Antonio I saw him not. Beatrice How tartly that gentleman looks! I never can see him but I am heart-burned an hour after. Hero He is of a very melancholy disposition. Beatrice He were an excellent man that were made just in the midway between him and Benedick: the one is too like an image and says nothing, and the other too like my lady’s eldest son, evermore tattling.
